basis.multi-turn-lineage: The immutable criteria and decision chain require preservation of corrections, rationale, rejected or superseded approaches, evidence gaps, commitments, and open questions.
basis.summary-authority: The contract treats generated summaries as lossy views and the durable event lineage as authoritative.
basis.research-first-resume: The frozen criterion requires brainstorm, research existing evidence, decide, execute, and independent verification with cross-host resume continuity.
basis.proactive-status: Deterministic pilot evidence derives a blocker when material omissions are not surfaced without reminders.
basis.summarizer-reminder: The held-out second-reminder summarizer and intake omission is frozen and deterministically detected.
